sections.title: Graphite, live
sections.intro: Classic, flat: a satin ring around a plain graphite dial on a dark background. This is the real wallpaper, drawn in your browser by the app's own code. Tap the big gauge, and try Graphite's layouts and colours.

qr.alt: A QR code that opens Speedometer Live Wallpaper on Google Play

labels.screen: Speedometer Live Wallpaper, live: tap the big gauge to switch it
labels.gauge: Tap the big gauge to switch between power, CPU clock and speed, as on your phone.
labels.getNote: A browser can’t set your wallpaper. Get the app on Google Play, open Styles and pick this one.

sections.title: About Graphite
sections.intro: Graphite is Classic at its plainest: a satin ring around a flat graphite dial on a dark background, with nothing shiny to pull your eye away from your icons.

items.alt: The Graphite style, as the wallpaper draws it
items.caption: Graphite, drawn by the app itself

items.title: Free
items.text: Graphite is free, like Classic and Steel.

items.title: One dial, three jobs
items.text: The big gauge shows power, CPU clock or GPS speed. Tap it on your home screen to switch, as in every style.

items.title: Make it yours
items.text: Customize sets Graphite's colours and background, and its units, clock and warning lights.

items.title: Layouts, and your own
items.text: Most styles come in several layouts. You can also drag and resize the gauges and save your own.

sections.title: Layouts made with Graphite
sections.intro: Drivers built these layouts in Graphite and shared them in the app's layout market, most used first. Every layout works in every style.

sections.title: More styles
sections.intro: Every style runs live on its own page. Or try them all in your browser.

image.alt: The Future style, as the wallpaper draws it

items.title: Future
items.text: The 2016 Future cluster: a chrome dial, the song that's playing, missed calls and messages.

image.alt: The Carbon style, as the wallpaper draws it

items.title: Carbon
items.text: A race dash: shift lights, the value huge on a race display with a rev bar, and bar meters.

image.alt: The Vintage style, as the wallpaper draws it

items.title: Vintage
items.text: A 1960s dashboard: a cream speedometer over a matching clock, both chrome-rimmed, on walnut.

image.alt: The Amber Night style, as the wallpaper draws it

items.title: Amber Night
items.text: Night luxury: one big amber-lit dial over a dot-matrix information display.
